Northeast India Gets First Dedicated Visa Application Centre

For the first time since India's independence, Northeast India has received a dedicated Visa Application Centre, located in Guwahati. This development also coincides with the introduction of a direct flight from Guwahati to Bangkok, scheduled to commence on October 27.
